<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>Login flow</title>
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #17181d;
  --bg-1: #1e2026;
  --bg-2: #24262e;
  --bg-3: #2c2f38;
  --bg-4: #363a45;
  --border: #33363f;
  --border-soft: #2a2d35;
  --line: #424755;
  --fg: #d4d8e0;
  --fg-dim: #9aa0b0;
  --fg-faint: #848a9c;
  --fg-bright: #e8ecf4;
  --accent: #5c9cf5;
  --accent-soft: rgba(92, 156, 245, 0.16);
  --accent-line: rgba(92, 156, 245, 0.45);
  --added: #4fbf7a;
  --modified: #e2b34c;
  --deleted: #e06c75;
  --violet: #a78bfa;
  --add-bg: rgba(79, 191, 122, 0.13);
  --del-bg: rgba(224, 108, 117, 0.13);
  --warn-bg: rgba(226, 179, 76, 0.07);
  --warn-line: rgba(226, 179, 76, 0.42);
  --tint: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028);
  --on-accent: #0f1116;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Inter", sans-serif;
  --code-px: 12px;
  --code-lh: 1.6;
  --ctl: 28px;
  --bar: 40px;
  --hdr: 34px;
  --r-sm: 5px;
  --r: 7px;
  --r-lg: 10px;
  --quick: 110ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  /* The chat's share of the width beside the code; the divider moves it (app.js). */
  --chat-w: 40%;
  /* Side padding of the thread and dock; artifacts bleed into it on phones. */
  --gutter: 20px;
  /* The widest the conversation gets: the thread, the activity line and the dock. */
  --measure: 1120px;
  --safe-t: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  --safe-r: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
  --safe-b: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  --safe-l: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
  color-scheme: dark;
}
/* The viewer's page: one artifact on its own (src/main.rs), in a browser tab or the iOS
   app. With app.css's :root tokens and openui.css. */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 13px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; padding: 0; touch-action: manipulation; }
input, textarea, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p, ul, ol, figure, blockquote { margin: 0; }
svg { flex: none; }
:focus { outline: none; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
.oui-page { max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; }
.oui-page-bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) 16px 0; background: var(--bg-2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); color: var(--fg-bright); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
.oui-page-bar span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
/* In the iOS app the card around it has the title already. */
.embedded .oui-page-bar { display: none; }

/* tamale's artifacts, drawn (src/lib.rs). Part of the web UI's stylesheet (tamale adds it
   to web/'s app.css), and of the viewer's page, with viewer.css. It uses the web UI's
   colour and type tokens (app.css's :root), which the viewer's page carries too. */

.oui {
  --oui-pad: 20px;
  /* What an artifact's parts sit on, for the few that must cover what's behind them. */
  --oui-surface: var(--bg);
  padding: var(--oui-pad);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--fg);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  min-width: 0;
  /* Its parts lay themselves out for its width, not the window's (`@container`, below): an
     artifact in a narrow chat beside the code is as narrow as one on a phone. */
  container-type: inline-size;
}
.oui > * + * { margin-top: 14px; }
.oui-empty { color: var(--fg-faint); font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 0; }
.oui-problems { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-problems summary { cursor: pointer; }
.oui-problems ul { margin: 6px 0 0 18px; }
.oui strong { color: var(--fg-bright); font-weight: 620; }
.oui code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.88em; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--fg-bright); }
.oui a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
/* A file's name, where the page opens files (the web UI's code view). */
.oui .pathlink { cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--line); text-underline-offset: 2.5px; transition: color var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui .pathlink:hover { color: var(--accent); text-decoration-color: var(--accent-line); }
.oui-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow-wrap: normal; }

/* The colours of code (openui::code's kinds), as the chat's code blocks have them. */
.oui .t-c { color: #6b7385; font-style: italic; }
.oui .t-s { color: #99c794; }
.oui .t-n, .oui .t-k { color: #f99157; }
.oui .t-kw { color: #c594c5; }
.oui .t-fn { color: #6699cc; }
.oui .t-ty, .oui .t-attr { color: #fac863; }
.oui .t-tag { color: #ec5f67; }
.oui .t-add { color: var(--added); }
.oui .t-del { color: var(--deleted); }
.oui .t-hd { color: var(--accent); }

/* layout */
.oui-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.oui-stack.row { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; }
.oui-stack.row > * { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 200px; }
.oui-stack.gap-s { gap: 8px; }
.oui-stack.gap-m { gap: 14px; }
.oui-stack.gap-l { gap: 24px; }
.oui-stack.align-center { align-items: center; }
.oui-stack.align-end { align-items: flex-end; }
.oui-stack.align-between { justify-content: space-between; }
.oui-grid { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(var(--min, 220px), 100%), 1fr)); }
.oui-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
/* A row of figures: as many across as fit. */
.oui-grid.metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(150px, 100%), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.oui-card { --oui-surface: var(--bg-1); background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; min-width: 0; }
.oui-card .oui-card { padding: 14px; gap: 10px; }
.oui-card.v-sunk { --oui-surface: var(--bg); background: var(--bg); border-color: var(--border-soft); }
.oui-card.v-accent { border-color: var(--accent-line); background: linear-gradient(var(--accent-soft), var(--accent-soft)), var(--bg-1); }
.oui-card.v-success { border-color: rgba(79, 191, 122, 0.45); }
.oui-card.v-warning { border-color: var(--warn-line); }
.oui-card.v-danger { border-color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 0.5); }
.oui-header h2 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--fg-bright); margin: 0; }
.oui-header p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--fg-dim); max-width: 78ch; }
/* A header inside a card that's inside another names that card, not the artifact. */
.oui-card .oui-card .oui-header h2 { font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.oui-card .oui-card .oui-header p { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 2px; }
.oui-inline-header { margin-top: 4px; }
.oui-inline-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-inline-header p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 13px; }
.oui-sep { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); margin: 4px 0; }

/* Tabs stay on one line: more than fit are scrolled to. */
.oui-tablist { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 14px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.oui-tablist::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.oui-tab { flex: none; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; color: var(--fg-dim); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; white-space: nowrap; touch-action: manipulation; transition: color var(--quick) var(--ease), border-color var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-tab:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.oui-tab.on { color: var(--fg-bright); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }
.oui-tab:focus-visible, .oui-btn:focus-visible, .oui-acc-head:focus-visible, .oui-tree-row:focus-visible, .oui-followup:focus-visible, .oui-dg-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); }
.oui-tabpanel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; min-width: 0; }

.oui-accordion { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg); overflow: hidden; }
.oui-acc + .oui-acc { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.oui-acc-head { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 550; color: var(--fg-bright); touch-action: manipulation; }
.oui-acc-head:hover { background: var(--tint); }
.oui-chev { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: var(--fg-faint); stroke-width: 1.6; transition: transform var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-acc.open .oui-chev { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.oui-acc-body { padding: 0 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

.oui-steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.oui-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; position: relative; padding-bottom: 16px; }
.oui-step:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
.oui-step:not(:last-child)::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 30px; bottom: 2px; width: 2px; background: var(--border); }
.oui-step-n { width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.oui-step.s-done .oui-step-n { background: rgba(79, 191, 122, 0.18); color: var(--added); }
.oui-step.s-active .oui-step-n { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-step.s-blocked .oui-step-n { background: rgba(224, 108, 117, 0.18); color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-step-body { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding-top: 3px; }
.oui-step-title { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-bright); }
/* Steps one at a time (Steps(items, "walk")). */
.oui-walk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg); min-width: 0; }
.oui-walk-bar { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.oui-walk-bar button { flex: 1; height: 20px; padding: 8px 0; background: var(--bg-4); background-clip: content-box; border-radius: 2px; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background-color var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-walk-bar button.seen { background-color: var(--accent-line); }
.oui-walk-bar button.on { background-color: var(--accent); }
.oui-walk-step { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; animation: oui-in 200ms var(--ease); }
.oui-walk-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-bright); }
.oui-walk-title .oui-step-n { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-walk-of { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--fg-faint); white-space: nowrap; }
.oui-walk-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
@keyframes oui-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.oui-pill, .oui-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; align-self: flex-start; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow-wrap: normal; }
.oui-pill.s-done, .oui-pill.t-good, .oui-tag.v-success { background: var(--add-bg); color: var(--added); }
.oui-pill.s-active, .oui-tag.v-accent { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.oui-pill.s-blocked, .oui-pill.t-bad, .oui-tag.v-danger { background: var(--del-bg); color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-tag.v-warning { background: rgba(226, 179, 76, 0.14); color: var(--modified); }
.oui-tag.v-violet { background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.15); color: var(--violet); }
.oui-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

/* content */
.oui-text { margin: 0; max-width: 72ch; }
.oui-text.size-small { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-dim); }
.oui-text.size-large { font-size: 16px; }
.oui-text.size-large-heavy { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--fg-bright); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.oui-md { max-width: 72ch; }
.oui-md > * { margin: 0; }
.oui-md > * + * { margin-top: 10px; }
.oui-md h3 { font-size: 15px; color: var(--fg-bright); }
.oui-md h4 { font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-bright); }
.oui-md * + h3, .oui-md * + h4 { margin-top: 16px; }
.oui-md ul, .oui-md ol { padding-left: 20px; }
.oui-md li + li { margin-top: 4px; }
.oui-md li::marker, .oui-list > li::marker { color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-md blockquote { border-left: 3px solid var(--border); padding-left: 12px; color: var(--fg-dim); }
.oui-md pre { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 10px 12px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
.oui-md pre code { background: none; border: none; padding: 0; font-size: inherit; color: var(--fg); }

.oui-callout { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 0 var(--r) var(--r) 0; padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.oui-callout strong { color: var(--fg-bright); font-weight: 650; }
.oui-callout.v-success { border-color: var(--added); background: var(--add-bg); }
.oui-callout.v-warning { border-color: var(--modified); background: rgba(226, 179, 76, 0.1); }
.oui-callout.v-danger { border-color: var(--deleted); background: var(--del-bg); }
.oui-callout.v-neutral { border-color: var(--line); background: var(--tint); }

.oui-code, .oui-diff { position: relative; margin: 0; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--r); overflow: hidden; min-width: 0; }
.oui-code figcaption, .oui-diff figcaption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 70px 6px 12px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fg-dim); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); background: var(--bg-1); }
.oui-diff figcaption { padding-right: 12px; }
.oui-diff-file { flex: 1; min-width: 0; color: var(--fg-bright); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.oui-add { color: var(--added); }
.oui-del { color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-diff-note { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-dim); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.oui-copy { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 6px; z-index: 1; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-dim); background: var(--bg-3); }
.oui-copy.done { color: var(--added); }
/* A grid, so every row is as wide as the widest and its colour runs the whole way. */
.oui-lines { display: grid; overflow-x: auto; padding: 6px 0; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; tab-size: 4; }
.oui-line { display: flex; }
.oui-line code { flex: 1; background: none; border: none; padding: 0 12px 0 0; border-radius: 0; font-size: inherit; color: var(--fg); white-space: pre; }
.oui-ind { white-space: pre; }
.oui-ln { flex: none; width: var(--ln, 3ch); padding: 0 10px 0 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--fg-faint); opacity: 0.7; user-select: none; box-sizing: content-box; }
.oui-ln.one { display: none; }
.oui-sign { flex: none; width: 1.5ch; color: var(--fg-faint); user-select: none; }
/* The lines a CodeBlock marks; the rest step back. */
.oui-line.mark { background: rgba(92, 156, 245, 0.13); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.oui-line.mark .oui-ln { color: var(--accent); opacity: 1; }
.oui-code.has-marks .oui-line:not(.mark) code { opacity: 0.55; }
.oui-line.d-add { background: var(--add-bg); }
.oui-line.d-add .oui-sign { color: var(--added); }
.oui-line.d-del { background: var(--del-bg); }
.oui-line.d-del .oui-sign { color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-line.d-hunk code, .oui-line.d-meta code, .oui-line.d-gap code { color: var(--fg-faint); padding-left: 12px; }
.oui-line.d-hunk { background: var(--tint); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); margin: 4px 0; font-size: 11.5px; }
.oui-line.d-hunk:first-child { margin-top: -6px; border-top: none; }
.oui-line.d-gap code { text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.3em; }
/* A diff whose hunks don't say where they are has no line numbers. */
.oui-diff.nonum .oui-ln { display: none; }
.oui-diff.nonum .oui-sign { padding-left: 10px; box-sizing: content-box; }

.oui-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--r); }
.oui-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.oui-table caption { caption-side: top; text-align: left; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 12px; }
.oui-table th { white-space: nowrap; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--fg-faint); background: var(--bg-2); }
/* Words break only where they must, so a column is at least as wide as its longest one. */
.oui-table th, .oui-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); vertical-align: top; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.oui-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.oui-table .c-number { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.oui-table td.c-number { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; }

.oui-metric { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 12px 14px; min-width: 0; }
.oui-metric-value { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--fg-bright); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.oui-metric-label { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 12.5px; }
.oui-progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.oui-track { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-3); overflow: hidden; }
.oui-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent); transition: width 300ms var(--ease); }
.oui-fill.t-good { background: var(--added); }
.oui-fill.t-bad { background: var(--deleted); }
.oui-fill.t-warning { background: var(--modified); }

.oui-list { margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.oui-list.v-plain { list-style: none; padding: 0; gap: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--r); overflow: hidden; }
.oui-list.v-plain > .oui-li + .oui-li { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
/* For and against, and what's done: each item under its own mark. */
.oui-list.v-pros, .oui-list.v-cons, .oui-list.v-check { list-style: none; padding: 0; gap: 6px; }
.oui-list.v-pros > .oui-li, .oui-list.v-cons > .oui-li, .oui-list.v-check > .oui-li { position: relative; padding-left: 24px; }
.oui-list.v-pros > .oui-li::before, .oui-list.v-cons > .oui-li::before, .oui-list.v-check > .oui-li::before { position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 0; font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; }
.oui-list.v-pros > .oui-li::before { content: "+"; color: var(--added); }
.oui-list.v-cons > .oui-li::before { content: "−"; color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-list.v-check > .oui-li::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--added); }
.oui-li-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; min-width: 0; }
.oui-list.v-plain .oui-li-row { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; }
.oui-li-row.tap { touch-action: manipulation; }

/* What a tone colours: a flow node's edge or dot, a diagram's box, a sequence's arrow. */

/* A diagram (src/diagram.rs): boxes in rows of a fixed height, arrows drawn between them. */

.oui-dg-edge-label { position: absolute; z-index: 2; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); max-width: 46%; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-3); font-size: 11px; line-height: 17px; color: var(--fg); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.oui-dg-readout { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px 8px; margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--tint); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-dim); }

/* A sequence: an actor a column, a message an arrow between two of their lines. */
.oui-seq { margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.oui-seq-actors { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--n, 2), minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.oui-seq-actor { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 0 3px; min-width: 0; }

.oui-seq-lanes span { justify-self: center; width: 0; border-left: 1.5px dashed var(--border); }

.oui-seq-msg.note .oui-seq-text { width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 2.5px solid var(--c); border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--bg-3); text-align: left; }
.oui-seq-msg.note .oui-seq-label, .oui-seq-msg.note .oui-seq-detail > :first-child { background: none; }

/* charts (src/charts.rs) */
.oui-chart { margin: 0; min-width: 0; --c0: var(--accent); --c1: var(--violet); --c2: var(--added); --c3: var(--modified); --c4: var(--deleted); --c5: #56b6c2; --c6: #f0a45d; --c7: #d16d9e; }
.c0 { --c: var(--c0); } .c1 { --c: var(--c1); } .c2 { --c: var(--c2); } .c3 { --c: var(--c3); } .c4 { --c: var(--c4); } .c5 { --c: var(--c5); } .c6 { --c: var(--c6); } .c7 { --c: var(--c7); }
.ct-accent { --c: var(--accent); } .ct-good { --c: var(--added); } .ct-bad { --c: var(--deleted); } .ct-warning { --c: var(--modified); } .ct-violet { --c: var(--violet); } .ct-neutral { --c: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-chart-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 18px; }
.oui-axis-title { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-axis-title.x { text-align: center; margin: 4px 0 0 40px; }
.oui-readout { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-bright); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }
.oui-plot { position: relative; height: 200px; margin: 18px 0 0 40px; }
.oui-gridline { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.oui-gridline span { position: absolute; right: calc(100% + 8px); top: -8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.oui-bars { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; }

.oui-col { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; max-width: 48px; min-width: 0; }
.oui-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; background: var(--c); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; opacity: 0.88; touch-action: manipulation; transition: opacity var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-bar.down { border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; }
.oui-bar:hover, .oui-bar.on { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--oui-surface), 0 0 0 3px var(--c); }
/* A mark's value, written by it where there are few enough marks to have room. */
.oui-bar-v, .oui-dot-v { display: none; position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1; color: var(--fg-dim); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; }
.oui-bar-v { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.oui-bar-v.down { margin: 4px 0 0; }
.oui-dot-v { bottom: calc(100% - 4px); }
.oui-plot.few .oui-bar-v, .oui-plot.few .oui-dot-v { display: block; }
.oui-xlabels { display: flex; margin-left: 40px; margin-top: 6px; }
.oui-xlabels span { flex: 1; min-width: 0; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0 2px; }
/* A line's labels sit under its points, not in equal shares of the width. */
.oui-xlabels.at { display: block; position: relative; height: 16px; }
.oui-xlabels.at span { position: absolute; top: 0; max-width: 28%; padding: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.oui-xlabels.at span.first { transform: none; }
.oui-xlabels.at span.last { transform: translateX(-100%); }
.oui-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-dim); }
.oui-legend > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.oui-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c); flex: none; display: inline-block; }
.oui-lines-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
.oui-line-path { fill: none; stroke: var(--c); stroke-width: 2; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.oui-area { fill: var(--c); opacity: 0.14; stroke: none; }
.oui-dot { position: absolute; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin: 0 0 -12px -12px; border-radius: 50%; touch-action: manipulation; }
.oui-dot::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--oui-surface); transition: inset var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-dot.on::after, .oui-dot:hover::after { inset: 6px; }
.oui-hbars { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.oui-hrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(80px, 32%) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.oui-hlabel { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.oui-htrack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.oui-hbar-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.oui-hbar-space { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; }
.oui-hbar { flex: none; height: 14px; min-width: 2px; background: var(--c); opacity: 0.88; }
.oui-hbar:first-child { border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px; }
.oui-hbar:last-child { border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; }
.oui-hbar:only-child { border-radius: 3px; }
.oui-hbar-line .oui-num { flex: none; min-width: 5ch; text-align: right; }
.oui-pie { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px 20px; }
.oui-pie-plot { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 160px; flex: none; }
.oui-pie-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.oui-pie-svg path { fill: var(--c); stroke: var(--oui-surface); stroke-width: 0.02; opacity: 0.88; cursor: pointer; }
.oui-pie-svg path.on, .oui-pie-svg path:hover { opacity: 1; }
.oui-pie-middle { position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 0 36px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; pointer-events: none; }
.oui-pie-middle strong { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.oui-pie-middle span { max-width: 100%; font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.oui-pie-legend { flex: 1 1 220px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.oui-pie-legend button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); text-align: left; font-size: 13px; }
.oui-pie-legend button.on, .oui-pie-legend button:hover { background: var(--tint); }
.oui-pie-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* controls */
.oui-buttons { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.oui-buttons.column { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
.oui-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--r); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-bright); border: 1px solid var(--border); touch-action: manipulation; transition: background var(--quick) var(--ease), border-color var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg-4); }
.oui-btn.v-primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-btn.v-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.08); background: var(--accent); }
.oui-btn.v-ghost { background: none; border-color: transparent; color: var(--accent); }
.oui-btn.v-danger { color: var(--deleted); border-color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 0.45); background: var(--del-bg); }
.oui-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }
.oui-followups { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.oui-followup { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--bg-2); text-align: left; color: var(--fg); touch-action: manipulation; }
.oui-followup:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent-line); color: var(--fg-bright); }
.oui-followup:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }
.oui-followup svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.oui-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.oui-form-fields { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.oui-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.oui-field-label { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-dim); }

.oui-field-error { font-size: 12px; color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--r); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg-bright); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; }
@media (min-width: 641px) { .oui-input { font-size: 14px; } }
.oui-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
textarea.oui-input { resize: vertical; }

.oui-segmented button { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-dim); touch-action: manipulation; }

.oui-knob { width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-4); position: relative; flex: none; transition: background var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-knob::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fg-bright); transition: transform var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-switch.on .oui-knob { background: var(--accent); }
.oui-switch.on .oui-knob::after { transform: translateX(16px); }

@container (min-width: 601px) {
  .oui-plot.some .oui-bar-v, .oui-plot.some .oui-dot-v { display: block; }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .oui { --oui-pad: 14px; font-size: 15px; }
}

/* A narrow artifact: on a phone, or in a chat that shares the window with the code. */
@container (max-width: 600px) {
  .oui-card { padding: 14px; }
  .oui-header h2 { font-size: 20px; }
  /* Two figures across, and a last one on its own takes the row. */
  .oui-grid.metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
  .oui-grid.metrics > :last-child:nth-child(odd) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .oui-metric { padding: 10px 12px; }
  .oui-metric-value { font-size: 22px; }

  /* The indentation is that padding, not spaces a long first word could wrap away from. */
  .oui-ind { display: none; }

  .oui-ln { padding: 0 8px 0 6px; }

  .oui-ln.two { display: none; }
  .oui-ln.one { display: block; }

  .oui-flow.row { display: flex; gap: 0; }
  .oui-flow.row .oui-flow-node { border: none; background: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 1px 0 14px 32px; }
  .oui-flow.row .oui-flow-node:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .oui-flow.row .oui-flow-node:not(:last-child)::after { left: 10px; top: 24px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; height: auto; border: none; background: var(--border); transform: none; }
  .oui-flow.row .oui-flow-n { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .oui-flow.row .oui-flow-node:not(.t-neutral) .oui-flow-n { background: var(--c); color: var(--on-accent); }
  .oui-flow.row .oui-flow-node:not(.t-neutral) .oui-flow-label { color: var(--c); }
  .oui-flow-label { font-size: 14px; }
  .oui-stack.row > * { flex-basis: 100%; }
  /* A step's number sits by its title, and what it says takes the whole width. */
  .oui-step { grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px 10px; padding-bottom: 18px; }
  .oui-step:not(:last-child)::before { display: none; }

  .oui-li-row { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px 12px; }
  .oui-li-main { flex-basis: 100%; }
  .oui-li-meta { max-width: 100%; text-align: left; }
  .oui-dg-node, .oui-dg-pass { width: calc(100% / var(--cols, 1) - 8px); }

  .oui-dg-label { font-size: 12px; }

  .oui-plot { margin-left: 34px; height: 180px; }
  .oui-xlabels, .oui-axis-title.x { margin-left: 34px; }

  /* Wide tables become a card a row: its first cell the card's title, the others beside

  .oui-table-wrap:has(.stack) { border: none; overflow: visible; }
  .oui-table.stack, .oui-table.stack caption, .oui-table.stack tbody, .oui-table.stack tr, .oui-table.stack td { display: block; width: auto; }
  .oui-table.stack caption { padding: 0 0 8px; }

  .oui-table.stack tr:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .oui-table.stack td { position: relative; min-height: 26px; border: none; padding: 3px 0 3px 38%; text-align: left; white-space: normal; }
  .oui-table.stack td:empty { display: none; }
  .oui-table.stack td::before { content: attr(data-label); position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; width: 35%; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--fg-faint); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .oui-table.stack td:first-child { padding: 0 0 6px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-bright); }

  .oui-hrow { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 3px; }
  .oui-hrow .oui-hlabel { white-space: normal; }
  .oui-talk-you { margin-left: 16px; }
  .oui-talk-tutor { margin-right: 0; }
  .oui-lesson-count { display: none; }
  .oui-lesson-nav { justify-content: space-between; }
  .oui-lesson h2.oui-lesson-title { font-size: 20px; }

/* lessons (src/lesson.rs): one part at a time, a rail of the parts, checks and a discussion */
.oui-lesson { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; scroll-margin-top: 12px; }
.oui-lesson-goal { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: linear-gradient(var(--accent-soft), var(--accent-soft)), var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--accent-line); }

.oui-lesson-goal .v { color: var(--fg-bright); font-weight: 550; }
.oui-lesson-rail { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; scrollbar-width: thin; counter-reset: stop; }
.oui-lesson-stop { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 220px; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 4px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 550; touch-action: manipulation; transition: all var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-lesson-stop:hover { border-color: var(--line); color: var(--fg); }
.oui-lesson-stop .n { flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-3); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.oui-lesson-stop .t { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.oui-lesson-stop.on { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg-bright); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.oui-lesson-stop.on .n { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-lesson-stop.done .n { background: var(--add-bg); color: var(--added); }
.oui-lesson-stop.started .n { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent-line); }
.oui-lesson-stop:focus-visible, .oui-quick:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.oui-lesson-part { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; animation: oui-lesson-in 220ms var(--ease); }
@keyframes oui-lesson-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.oui-lesson-level { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); font-weight: 550; }
.oui-lesson-level .lvl { padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.15); color: var(--violet); font-weight: 600; }
.oui-lesson h2.oui-lesson-title { margin: -6px 0 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--fg-bright); }
.oui-lesson-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; min-width: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; }
.oui-lesson-checks, .oui-talk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.oui-lesson-checks h3, .oui-talk h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-check { --oui-surface: var(--bg-1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: var(--bg-1); }
.oui-check.answered { border-color: rgba(79, 191, 122, 0.4); }
.oui-check-q { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; color: var(--fg-bright); font-weight: 550; }
.oui-check-q .mark { flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.oui-check.answered .oui-check-q .mark { background: var(--add-bg); color: var(--added); }
.oui-check textarea.oui-input, .oui-talk textarea.oui-input { width: 100%; resize: vertical; font: inherit; }
.oui-check-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.oui-check-row .spacer { flex: 1; }
.oui-check-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-check-more { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-dim); }
.oui-check-more summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 550; width: fit-content; }
.oui-check-more > div { margin-top: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; border-left: 2px solid var(--border); }
.oui-quick-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.oui-quick { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 12px 6px 6px; border-radius: var(--r); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); text-align: left; touch-action: manipulation; transition: all var(--quick) var(--ease); }
.oui-quick:hover { border-color: var(--line); }
.oui-quick .l { flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-3); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--fg-dim); }
.oui-quick.on { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.oui-quick.on .l { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-quick.right { border-color: rgba(79, 191, 122, 0.6); background: var(--add-bg); }
.oui-quick.right .l { background: var(--added); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-quick.wrong { border-color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 0.6); background: var(--del-bg); }
.oui-quick.wrong .l { background: var(--deleted); color: var(--on-accent); }
.oui-quick.dim { opacity: 0.6; }
.oui-quick-why { font-size: 13.5px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--r); }
.oui-quick-why.right { background: var(--add-bg); }
.oui-quick-why.right strong { color: var(--added); }
.oui-quick-why.wrong { background: var(--del-bg); }
.oui-quick-why.wrong strong { color: var(--deleted); }
.oui-talk-x { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

.oui-talk-tutor { background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border); margin-right: 32px; }
.oui-talk .who { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-talk-tutor .who { color: var(--violet); }
.oui-talk-you .about { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-dim); }
.oui-talk-you .said { white-space: pre-wrap; }
.oui-talk-tutor .said > :first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.oui-talk-tutor .said > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.oui-talk-none { color: var(--fg-faint); font-size: 13px; }
.oui-talk-wait { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 0; }
.oui-talk-wait span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fg-faint); animation: oui-talk-dot 1.2s infinite ease-in-out; }
.oui-talk-wait span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.oui-talk-wait span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
@keyframes oui-talk-dot { 0%, 80%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; } 40% { opacity: 1; } }
.oui-talk-ask { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-end; }
.oui-talk-ask textarea { flex: 1; }
.oui-lesson-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.oui-lesson-count { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oui-lesson-offline { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); margin: 0; }
